purpose: Develop generic observational diagnostics against platform-neutral synthetic positive and negative controls. No vehicle/controller trials.

diagnostic_recipe.folds: leave one whole diagnostic recording out
diagnostic_recipe.replacement_control: older features from other training recordings; held-out donors use training recordings only

fresh_data.policy_controls: u=x^2 or x^3; next x is independent uniform[-1,1]

measurement: Cross-recording remaining input RMS vs training-mean reference; raw model error and errors after short/extended/replacement-history diagnostic regressions. No binary thresholds, causal independence claim, or model update.
exclusions: Diagnostic recordings must differ in identity and full content from fit/development data. Old synthetic cases are already inspected and are method-development data, not an untouched final benchmark.
next_claim: Do these descriptive signals separate the stipulated examples, and which negative controls expose blind spots?
